scenarios.title: Clean bootstrap
scenarios.given: Fresh repository and local Supabase test environment
scenarios.when: Run installed scripts and test DB reset
scenarios.then: App shell builds; reset creates schema and deterministic fixtures without calling external providers.

scenarios.title: Schema constraints
scenarios.given: Reference schema and auth fixture users
scenarios.when: Insert grant with both subjects, bad dates, duplicate offering enrollment or cross-version progress
scenarios.then: Each statement fails the relevant CHECK/UNIQUE/FK; transaction does not leave a partial row.

scenarios.title: No direct table access
scenarios.given: anon and authenticated DB roles
scenarios.when: SELECT or INSERT app.enrollments, including through Data API
scenarios.then: Permission denied or inaccessible schema; no row data disclosed.

scenarios.title: Function privilege boundary
scenarios.given: Authenticated learner token
scenarios.when: Call pglearn_job/provision or unknown pglearn_rpc action
scenarios.then: Service functions deny execute; unknown action returns stable denial and makes no changes.

scenarios.title: Cross-context relationship
scenarios.given: Org A grant and org B cohort
scenarios.when: Create offering referencing mismatched grant/cohort via handler or privileged insert test
scenarios.then: Relationship trigger rejects; no offering/enrollment created.

scenarios.title: Session and profile authority
scenarios.given: Signed-in learner with manipulated profile fields/cookie role metadata
scenarios.when: Try to set platform_admin, email or organization role through update_me
scenarios.then: Unknown fields rejected; DB authority remains unchanged.

scenarios.title: Anonymous and logout
scenarios.given: Unauthenticated or server-revoked session
scenarios.when: Open protected class/API
scenarios.then: Page redirects to login; API returns 401; no cached content from another user.

scenarios.title: Invitation acceptance
scenarios.given: Pending unexpired invitation for amber
scenarios.when: Accept as amber, then retry; separately try as ben
scenarios.then: Amber becomes onboarded/active once; retry returns same state; ben gets 404.

scenarios.title: New versus existing account
scenarios.given: One new email and one existing verified user
scenarios.when: Invite both and follow email/callback
scenarios.then: New user sets password before onboarding; existing user signs in and accepts without password reset; neither gains access before acceptance.

scenarios.title: Invitation retry and expiry
scenarios.given: Repeated create request ID; expired invitation; missing mail response
scenarios.when: Retry same request, then explicitly resend expired invitation
scenarios.then: No duplicate membership/enrollment; resend replaces invitation with 24h expiry; private Auth link never returned to manager.

scenarios.title: Last manager and scope
scenarios.given: One active manager A
scenarios.when: Remove/demote manager or have manager A invite manager B/promote learner
scenarios.then: Last-manager change fails 409; manager role promotion/foreign-org action denied.

scenarios.title: Cohort membership removal
scenarios.given: Active enrolled cohort learner
scenarios.when: Remove learner from cohort, then re-add
scenarios.then: Prior progress retained; enrollment cancelled; re-add alone does not reactivate; explicit valid reactivation restores access.

scenarios.title: Catalog subject and expiry
scenarios.given: A grant, personal grant, and B-only program
scenarios.when: Manager A lists catalog/grants then assigns B-only content or personal grant
scenarios.then: Only own entitled summaries visible; invalid assignment denied; personal grant never grants A access.

scenarios.title: Draft editing and ordering
scenarios.given: Two modules with existing classes
scenarios.when: Reorder complete sibling list then submit duplicate/foreign ID list
scenarios.then: Valid order contiguous and persisted; invalid reorder rejected atomically.

scenarios.title: Asset upload authorization
scenarios.given: Admin draft class and learner token
scenarios.when: Authorize supported upload as admin; try learner upload or path traversal filename
scenarios.then: Admin receives exact scoped upload permission; learner denied; key sanitized/no traversal.

scenarios.title: Upload finalization
scenarios.given: Uploaded object with declared/actual mismatch or invalid SRT
scenarios.when: Finalize upload
scenarios.then: Asset not ready; stable error shown; class cannot publish until corrected.

scenarios.title: Caption conversion
scenarios.given: Valid English SRT with timestamps and overlapping cues
scenarios.when: Finalize caption then play generated VTT
scenarios.then: Timestamps/text preserved, overlap allowed, invalid end<=start rejected, raw HTML not executed.

scenarios.title: Publication guard
scenarios.given: Draft missing required source/caption or all classes optional
scenarios.when: Publish
scenarios.then: 422 PUBLISH_INCOMPLETE with specific fields; version remains draft.

scenarios.title: Published immutability
scenarios.given: Published version with enrollment
scenarios.when: Edit/delete class/assets through route or DB privileged test
scenarios.then: VERSION_PUBLISHED/trigger rejection; original denominator/source/assets unchanged.

scenarios.title: Enrollment uniqueness
scenarios.given: Eligible active/invited cohort members
scenarios.when: Assign same offering twice
scenarios.then: Same enrollment IDs returned; assigned count unchanged on second call.

scenarios.title: Personal and multi-org privacy
scenarios.given: personal and multi fixture accounts
scenarios.when: List own enrollments and manager A reports
scenarios.then: Personal learner works without org; manager A sees only A records; multi progress in B is unaffected by A updates.

scenarios.title: Time boundaries
scenarios.given: Start S, due D, hard end E, active grant
scenarios.when: Read/write at S, D, D+1ms, E
scenarios.then: S permits access; completion at D is on time; D+1ms may complete late; E rejects new learning writes.

scenarios.title: Grant revoked during session
scenarios.given: Authorized playing learner with valid URL
scenarios.when: Revoke grant, request next heartbeat/download renewal
scenarios.then: Write/renewal rejected; existing issued link may remain usable only until expiry; prior progress retained.

scenarios.title: Cross-session resume
scenarios.given: Acknowledged position 125000ms
scenarios.when: Reload and log in on another browser then Continue
scenarios.then: Same enrollment/class/position restored; no automatic completion from opening.

scenarios.title: Interval coverage threshold
scenarios.given: 600000ms media and no exercise
scenarios.when: Accumulate unique [0,539999) then extend to 540000
scenarios.then: First content incomplete; at 540000 content completes exactly; overlapping replay adds zero duplicate coverage.

scenarios.title: Seek is not playback
scenarios.given: New 600000ms media session
scenarios.when: Seek to 590000 then submit plausible played [590000,600000)
scenarios.then: Coverage=10000ms, class incomplete despite position at end.

scenarios.title: Heartbeat replay/order
scenarios.given: Accepted sequence 3 and event UUID
scenarios.when: Retry identical event; send new event sequence 2; reuse event with different body
scenarios.then: Identical replay no new credit; stale accepted=false; changed payload returns 409; position/completion never regresses.

scenarios.title: Two playback tabs
scenarios.given: Session A active then session B starts for same enrollment
scenarios.when: Send heartbeat from A then from B
scenarios.then: A gets 409 SESSION_SUPERSEDED; B writes; old tab cannot overwrite resume.

scenarios.title: Impossible progress evidence
scenarios.given: 15s elapsed at rate 1
scenarios.when: Submit 500000ms interval or negative/out-of-duration positions
scenarios.then: 422 INVALID_PROGRESS and no state change.

scenarios.title: Text explicit completion
scenarios.given: Required text class viewed
scenarios.when: GET class then POST text completion
scenarios.then: GET leaves completion null; POST sets content complete and follows exercise rule.

scenarios.title: Exercise Unicode validation
scenarios.given: Uncompleted exercise
scenarios.when: Submit whitespace-only, confirmation false, 2000 code points, and 2001 code points
scenarios.then: First two reject; 2000 accepts with confirmation; 2001 rejects consistently in UI/API/DB.

scenarios.title: Exercise atomicity and access
scenarios.given: Learner owns active matching enrollment
scenarios.when: Inject transaction failure while saving response; attempt foreign enrollment/class exercise
scenarios.then: No response/completion on failure; cross-context request denied; retry succeeds once.

scenarios.title: Exercise before content
scenarios.given: Required media class incomplete
scenarios.when: Save response/confirmation then finish media
scenarios.then: Exercise saved read-only; class stays incomplete until media criterion then completes once.

scenarios.title: Concurrent final completion
scenarios.given: All but final criterion complete
scenarios.when: Submit two concurrent final completions
scenarios.then: One enrollment completion timestamp, one certificate and one certificate notification event.

scenarios.title: Certificate access and snapshot
scenarios.given: Cora issued certificate
scenarios.when: Rename profile; expire course; attempt other-user PDF; revoke certificate
scenarios.then: Original name remains; owner can download after expiry; unauthorized gets 404; after revocation metadata remains and PDF returns 409.

scenarios.title: Report fixture reconciliation
scenarios.given: Offering A fixed fixture at fixtures.now
scenarios.when: Query report and CSV
scenarios.then: assigned=4, not_started=2, in_progress=1, completed=1, overdue=3, completion_rate=25, average_progress=41.7.

scenarios.title: Empty and filtered reports
scenarios.given: No matching enrollment or completed time filter
scenarios.when: Query report
scenarios.then: Empty denominator returns null; completed filters exclude incomplete; summary uses all matching records not just one page.

scenarios.title: CSV injection and scope
scenarios.given: Learner name begins whitespace then = and manager A token
scenarios.when: Export CSV including manipulated org filter
scenarios.then: Dangerous field prefixed with quote and RFC4180 escaped; foreign org filter denied; no chat/response body column.

scenarios.title: Authorized retrieval
scenarios.given: A learner and B-only source chunks
scenarios.when: Ask course question attempting to retrieve B course
scenarios.then: Only pinned authorized version chunks enter provider input; B text and other conversations absent.

scenarios.title: Valid tutor output
scenarios.given: Retrieved source IDs and useful course question
scenarios.when: Provider returns explanation/example with valid subset citations
scenarios.then: Validated answer shown with server-built class links; example labeled illustrative.

scenarios.title: Invalid/unsupported tutor output
scenarios.given: Empty sources or fabricated citation/refused/incomplete JSON
scenarios.when: Ask question
scenarios.then: Empty corpus returns unsupported without call; invalid model response fails visibly, invents no citation, does not block class progress.

scenarios.title: Tutor prompt injection
scenarios.given: Course text contains instruction to expose secrets or alter progress
scenarios.when: Ask for example
scenarios.then: Text treated as data; no secrets/tools supplied; no progress writes; reviewed output stays within learning scope.

scenarios.title: Tutor concurrency and budget
scenarios.given: Near monthly budget, duplicate request ID, daily limit
scenarios.when: Issue concurrent/retried requests
scenarios.then: Atomic reservation prevents overspend under configured rates; duplicate pending yields 409; quota exhausted 429; no repeat provider invocation.

scenarios.title: Tutor timeout and privacy
scenarios.given: Model timeout and own prior chat
scenarios.when: Refresh request; manager attempts history
scenarios.then: Existing failure/pending status retrieved without auto-send; unknown cost reservation retained; manager gets 404.

scenarios.title: Reminder priority and daily cap
scenarios.given: Amber overdue and inactive, one second due enrollment
scenarios.when: Run scheduler twice at local noon
scenarios.then: One highest-priority learning outbox event/user/local date; duplicate run makes no new send; pending Dana receives none.

scenarios.title: Reminder date/time rules
scenarios.given: Local date at due-3, due day, overdue and 08:59/09:00
scenarios.when: Evaluate rules with fixed clock including DST timezone
scenarios.then: Only correct local date/rule eligible in 09:00–17:59; no duplicate local-day send after DST offset change.

scenarios.title: Completion and preference suppression
scenarios.given: Outbox pending, learner completes or opts out/revokes access
scenarios.when: Dispatcher claims then rechecks before provider call
scenarios.then: Pending learning mail suppressed; no provider call; already-dispatched email cannot be recalled.

scenarios.title: Email uncertain send
scenarios.given: Provider timeout after possible acceptance
scenarios.when: Retry within window then recover at 23h+
scenarios.then: Same key/payload within window; at cutoff uncertain, no blind resend; daily slot retained.

scenarios.title: Email webhook ordering
scenarios.given: Valid delivered callback before provider ID save; duplicate event; forged signature
scenarios.when: Process and reconcile callbacks
scenarios.then: One event record; reconciliation reaches delivered; accepted callback cannot downgrade it; forged event 401/no write.

scenarios.title: Cron authentication
scenarios.given: GET scheduler with user session, bad secret and correct CRON_SECRET
scenarios.when: Invoke routes
scenarios.then: Only correct Bearer secret runs; job persisted; normal read routes do not mutate.

scenarios.title: Operations redaction
scenarios.given: Failed invitation with action link in private outbox payload
scenarios.when: Admin opens operations, inspect logs/browser bundle
scenarios.then: Status available; signed link/cookie/key/prompt/response body absent.

scenarios.title: Published media real check
scenarios.given: Supplied real video/captions uploaded privately
scenarios.when: Play/seek/renew at 390px and desktop; reload resume
scenarios.then: Actual media plays with captions; expired URL reauthorizes without losing position; no public object URL.

scenarios.title: Accessible UI states
scenarios.given: All primary forms and class player
scenarios.when: Keyboard navigate; trigger empty/loading/validation/provider errors
scenarios.then: Visible focus, labels, retained inputs and live save/error status; no keyboard trap; course works if tutor fails.

scenarios.title: End-to-end demo
scenarios.given: Controlled manager/admin/learner and real provider credentials/assets
scenarios.when: Follow demo script
scenarios.then: Publish→grant→invite→enroll→learn→response→certificate→report works; real controlled reminder/tutor verified; mocked-only features disclosed incomplete.

scenarios.title: Bulk import validation
scenarios.given: CSV with duplicates, bad email and foreign context
scenarios.when: Preview then apply valid rows
scenarios.then: Preview identifies issues; explicit apply idempotent; manager cannot assign foreign org/role; output reconciles counts.

scenarios.title: New version isolation
scenarios.given: Published version with existing enrollments
scenarios.when: Clone draft, edit content, publish version 2
scenarios.then: Existing learners keep original IDs/requirements/media; new assignment can select v2; no silent migration.

scenarios.title: Retention and budget ledger
scenarios.given: Chat >30 days, current month usage, raw progress events
scenarios.when: Run retention job
scenarios.then: Expired text/links removed; progress/certificates remain; durable no-text usage ledger preserves monthly accounting.

scenarios.title: Backup restore
scenarios.given: Disposable test target and database/asset backups
scenarios.when: Restore and verify learner record and referenced media
scenarios.then: Acknowledged progress/certificate recover and asset bytes exist; documented RPO<=24h and recovery steps measured.

scenarios.title: Forty-user load
scenarios.given: Realistic 40 synthetic learners with seeded program
scenarios.when: Exercise concurrent dashboard/progress and report reads
scenarios.then: No lost acknowledged updates/isolation failures; measure p95 data operation<1s and dashboard usable<3s on stated network; report failures instead of assuming pass.

scenarios.title: Pilot gate
scenarios.given: All pilot tasks implemented and content/manager ready
scenarios.when: Run full release checklist before real cohort onboarding
scenarios.then: All mandatory scenario evidence present; manager can operate without DB changes; unresolved critical security/progress defect blocks release.

scenarios.title: Transcript and content evaluation
scenarios.given: Real nine-video course source text
scenarios.when: Review 12 real questions: 5 explanations,4 examples,3 unsupported plus adversarial cases
scenarios.then: Owner finds explanations/examples useful and grounded; no fabricated sources or unauthorized content; failures recorded for correction.

scenarios.title: Signed URL reauthorization
scenarios.given: Previously authorized download key and now revoked grant
scenarios.when: Replay original Idempotency-Key to download authorization
scenarios.then: Replay rechecks access and rejects; never returns a newly valid URL from stale permission.

scenarios.title: Soft date bulk update
scenarios.given: One valid and one invalid selected enrollment
scenarios.when: Update offering dates and explicit selected enrollments
scenarios.then: All-or-nothing validation; no completed schedule changed; omitted enrollments retain copied dates, current offering/grant hard gates still apply.

scenarios.title: Foreign Origin mutation
scenarios.given: Valid session cookie, attacker Origin
scenarios.when: POST a learning/admin mutation
scenarios.then: 403 before state change; trusted same-origin route works; signed provider webhooks use separate verification.

scenarios.title: Profile removal preserves history
scenarios.given: Multi-org learner removed from A
scenarios.when: Read own summaries/certificates and learn in B
scenarios.then: A learning blocked, A history owned still visible, B and personal entitlement unaffected.

scenarios.title: Learner navigation states
scenarios.given: Owned, blocked and absent fixture enrollments
scenarios.when: Open dashboard and class/outline routes
scenarios.then: Owned enrollment renders correct outline; empty/blocked states are clear; unauthorized IDs denied; no completion is caused by GET.

scenarios.title: Tutor interaction states
scenarios.given: Class tutor drawer and injected success/unsupported/failure responses
scenarios.when: Send question and observe pending, completed and failed requests
scenarios.then: Pending indicator shown; source links validated; example labeled; input retained on failure; navigation/progress unaffected.
